name: Deshi Shahi Goru
description: A healthy and well-fed deshi cow raised on natural grass and hay. Calm temperament, perfect for Qurbani. Verified by local veterinarian.

name: Shahiwal Premium Bull
description: A premium Sahiwal breed bull known for its large build and healthy physique. Raised on organic feed with regular health checkups. Ideal for large family Qurbani.

name: Brahman Giant
description: Massive Brahman bull, one of the finest available this season. Well-muscled, disease-free, and raised in a hygienic farm environment. Great for group Qurbani.

name: Deshi Khasi Chagol
description: Classic Black Bengal goat, the most popular breed for Qurbani in Bangladesh. Healthy, active, and well-nourished. Perfect for individuals or small families.

name: Jamuna Pari Chagol
description: Jamunapari is a large-breed goat known for its impressive size and meaty build. This one is farm-raised with premium feed, fully vaccinated and vet-checked.

name: Boer Hybrid Chagol
description: A Boer hybrid goat with exceptional meat yield. One of the most sought-after breeds for Qurbani due to its heavy body weight. Raised in a commercial farm with top-tier care.

name: Hariana Bail
description: Hariana breed bull with a lean and muscular frame. Known for high-quality meat. Raised on a mix of natural grass and protein-rich feed. Fully healthy and active.

name: Sirohi Premium Bakri
description: Sirohi breed goat with a sturdy build and high adaptability. Commonly used for Qurbani due to its good meat ratio. Farm-raised, vaccinated, and ready for the season.
